subject: Periodic pauses of durable write confirmation on SQLite-backed Durable Objects and D1
workers: ed25519-yao-ab-benchmark-a and -b (probe script, deleted after every run)

definitions.wait: time from a write until ctx.storage.sync() resolved (sync) or until an outgoing fetch returned (fetch), by the object clock
definitions.stalled: a wait more than 20 ms above the median of its stream
definitions.stallWindow: a run of stalled ticks, stored as [start, duration, 1 if on the 5,000 ms cycle of the stream, the waits of its stalled writes in tick order]; the start is the first stalled write and the duration runs to the latest confirmation; the hourly rounds store the count of stalled writes in place of their waits
definitions.waitHistogram: every sample of a stream: wait in ms -> number of samples
definitions.host: the fl value of cdn-cgi/trace as fetched from inside the object
definitions.times: Unix milliseconds by the clock of the object or Worker
definitions.hostsRun: [colo, host, Worker name a or b, cycle phase or null, [[start, duration] of each stall window]]
definitions.oneLayerDown: inPause: the ticks inside a measured stall window on the cycle; for the quiet mode, the first 200 ms after each tick of the cycle
